잠언 5:1.content: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

잠언 5:2.content: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

잠언 5:3.content: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

잠언 5:4.content: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

잠언 5:5.content: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

잠언 5:6.content: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

잠언 5:7.content: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

잠언 5:8.content: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

잠언 5:9.content: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

잠언 5:10.content: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

잠언 5:11.content: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

잠언 5:12.content: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

잠언 5:13.content: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

잠언 5:14.content: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

잠언 5:15.content: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

잠언 5:16.content: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

잠언 5:17.content: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.

잠언 5:18.content: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

잠언 5:19.content: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

잠언 5:20.content: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

잠언 5:21.content: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.

잠언 5:22.content: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

잠언 5:23.content: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
